evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models are increasingly used to answer questions over financial filings, where an unfaithful answer can mislead investment, compliance, or client decisions.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The detector reaches 80.2% binary accuracy but only 44.7% subtype accuracy, never assigns two of the nine categories, and misses between 5.3% and 46.8% of hallucinations depending on category; these misses are unrelated to input length but rise with how far an answer departs from the correct one.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: We then generate hallucinations in nine financially motivated categories, confirm each with a separate verification pass, and diagnose an LLM-based detector on 4,086 usable examples.
